title: Fun at the Fair
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds air, ure, er
note_for_grown_ups: A Phase 3 book that mixes lots of the teams together — ai, ee, air, or, ar and more. If a word is tricky, cover part of it and build it up one team at a time.

pages.text: Fig and Nell set off to the fair.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar and Nell the bee arriving at a small country fair — bunting, stripey tents, a distant big wheel. Busy, colourful, festive.
Wide fairground scene packed with detail: stalls, flags, lights just coming on at dusk. The kind of page a child pores over.
Nell hovering in front of an enormous painted fairground chair-swing, dwarfed by it, front legs up in wonder.
Looking straight up at the chair-swing at the top of its arc against the sky, tiny and terrifying. Vertical composition.
Fig on the ground with his little face turned towards a cheering crowd off-page, all his legs braced. Sound shown by the crowd's raised arms.
A cheerful stallholder behind a steaming corn stall, cobs stacked in golden rows, warm light and steam. Rich, appetising detail.

pages.text: Nell had corn on the cob.
pages.illustration: Nell astride a corn cob almost as long as she is, eating along it like a tiny yellow harvester. Very funny.
Fig holding up a bright red paper party hat he has won, all his legs off the ground with pride. The hat catches the fairground lights.
Closing page: the two of them walking home in the dark, the fair glowing small behind them, Fig wearing the red hat.
